_description: Globally authoritative risk-management policy for Backtest, Historical Replay and Forward/Paper. Overrides any legacy 'risk' block in strategy presets.
_validation: Phase 2 frozen: Backtest <-> Historical Replay parity PASS on 2024-01-01 -> 2026-08-15 (91,968 candles, 626 comparable closed trades, 0 mismatches)
_convention: risk_per_trade_pct is a GROSS price-risk budget; fees/slippage accounted separately. max_position_allocation_pct is the max fraction of equity committed as MARGIN (max_notional = equity * alloc * leverage).
